description: This file defines an interface named CacheProvider, which provides a method to retrieve cache instances by name, supporting generics for key-value types and potentially returning null if no cache is available with the specified name.

classes.name: CacheProvider
classes.description: An interface for providing cache instances, allowing retrieval of cache objects by name.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Returns a cache instance by its name, supporting generic key-value types. May return null if no cache is available with the specified name.
